executionBoundary: M4 binds final prompt/tool/projection/adapter versions and exact code/configuration hashes; M5 obtains spend approval then executes real user -> VulpesAgent -> services/tools -> answer path. No M0 runner or calls.

candidateSlots.selection: current Luna everyday configuration at execution revision
one genuinely supported Luna higher-effort setting; otherwise not_applicable, never emulated
one currently available compatible everyday peer required live in M5

candidateFilters: Exact current model/API ID and availability
Actual effort semantics and adapter compatibility
Current full-task prices including continuations; source URL and checked date

scoring.unit: Complete scenario including all continuations/parameter variants; repeat outcomes disclosed individually, not extra denominator opportunities
scoring.ordinaryScenarioPass: All material expected facts/numbers/evidence references and tool/permission predicates hold in every required repetition; human semantic and usefulness each >=1
scoring.denominator: Freeze eligible scenarios before comparative results. Missing required product coverage (including E11) blocks final acceptance; never drop it to reach 90%. Publish failures, skips and applicability decisions.
scoring.offlineControlPolicy: Record E20 and deterministic E16/E19 controls separately; an offline pass cannot count as live model quality. Ordinary cases still require actual production-path answers.
selectionOrder: observed latency, variation and practical failure impact

repetitions.shortlisted: At least two runs for every critical or difficult scenario, including continuations and E17/E20 variants in approval matrix
repetitions.controls: Repeat deterministic denial assertions offline; do not pay merely to repeat zero-dispatch control
repetitions.heldOut: E04,E07,E11 reserved for final verification; do not tune on them. Because prompts are public, use fresh numerically equivalent variants if anyone has tuned against these cases; bind independent oracles before execution.

runEnvelope.changePolicy: Only later measured and reviewed evidence can change this envelope

approvalPacket: Named operator and separate verification allocation
Exact candidate IDs/settings and privacy/capability/price source dates
Approved maximum spend and conservative reservation per request/task
Case x candidate x repetition x variant matrix including continuations
Interruption/unknown-charge procedure; halt on critical failure or budget ceiling
conditionalPolicies: Prefer one fixed-effort model. Adaptive effort or at most one stronger handoff only after a defined residual difficult-case failure and measured full-task benefit; preserve consent, fresh budget admission, global limits and truthful terminal states. Never ship both by default.
